followed_sources_checked.notes: Checked Stanford SVL / BEHAVIOR surfaces for new executable-world and embodied benchmark signals; no new accepted additions this run.
Checked Princeton PVL and Infinigen surfaces for new procedural world-generation releases; no new accepted candidate beyond existing registry coverage.
Checked Ai2 embodied surfaces and found vla-eval as the strongest new infrastructure addition this run.
NVIDIA Cosmos surfaces yielded Cosmos-Predict2.5 as a direct accepted world-model addition; Cosmos-Reason1 was logged but not promoted.
Checked REAL lab surfaces; no clean new accepted addition beyond already covered manipulation and scene-generation lines.
Checked Stanford IRIS / OpenVLA surfaces; no new accepted primary-source addition beyond existing registry coverage.
Checked Berkeley RAIL / BAIR robotics signal space; broad search did not yield a cleaner accepted candidate than the VLA infrastructure additions already selected.
Checked Physical Intelligence surfaces; no new accepted paper this run.
Checked Google DeepMind robotics surfaces; no new accepted primary-source addition for the current branch scope.
Checked UT Austin RPL surfaces; no new accepted addition emerged in this run window.
Checked Meta FAIR embodied signals; nothing newly accepted this run.
Checked LeRobot release surfaces for reinforcement of recent VLA releases; no standalone accepted candidate from this source group.
Checked TRI research surfaces; no new accepted addition this run.
SceneCode was recovered through broad primary-source search and is relevant to the scene-generation / executable-world line tracked here.
World-model and VLA benchmark searches produced SpatialAct, VLA-REPLICA, and the SO-101 benchmark candidate; only the first two cleared the acceptance gates.
Used VLA benchmark and leaderboard search space to cross-check current evaluation infrastructure candidates.
Survey pages were not needed once direct primary and official benchmark sources were recovered for the accepted E-branch candidates.

candidates.title: SceneCode: Editable Indoor Scene Generation using Executable World Programs
candidates.why_candidate: Executable scene-program representation with official project page and clear relevance to structured world generation and editing.

candidates.title: SimWorld Studio: Generation and Evolution of Custom Embodied Agent Learning Environments
candidates.why_candidate: Generation-and-evolution system for embodied learning environments with official site, public code, and benchmark-scale evidence.

candidates.title: SpatialAct: Probing Spatial Reasoning-to-Action Capabilities of Vision-Language Models in 3D Scenes
candidates.why_candidate: Benchmark directly aligned with reasoning-to-action spatial evaluation, with official project page and clean 3D-scene task coverage.

candidates.title: Cosmos-Predict2.5: A World Foundation Model for Physical AI
candidates.why_candidate: Official NVIDIA world-model release with large-scale data, public artifacts, and strong action-conditioned future-prediction demos.

candidates.title: A Unified Evaluation Harness for Vision-Language-Action Models
candidates.why_candidate: Direct evaluation-infrastructure addition with official GitHub and broad benchmark standardization value.

candidates.title: VLA-REPLICA: A Low-Cost, Reproducible Benchmark for Real-World Evaluation of Vision-Language-Action Models
candidates.why_candidate: Primary-source-backed low-cost real-world VLA benchmark with official project page and explicit reproducibility framing.

candidates.title: Cosmos-Reason1: From Physical Common Sense To Embodied Reasoning
candidates.why_candidate: Potentially useful embodied reasoning background addition, but branch fit and action-level project relevance are weaker than the accepted set.

candidates.title: Benchmarking VLA Models on the SO-101 Robot
candidates.why_candidate: Real-robot VLA benchmark candidate, but narrower and less reusable than VLA-REPLICA plus vla-eval.

triage.reason: Primary paper plus official project page; strong fit for executable scene structure and editing.
Official release with public code and strong embodied environment-generation relevance.
Benchmark cleanly targets spatial reasoning-to-action in 3D scenes and has an official project page.
Official NVIDIA world-model release with strong scale, demos, and direct world-action relevance.
Primary paper and official GitHub provide strong evidence for reusable VLA evaluation infrastructure.
Low-cost real-world benchmark with explicit reproducibility focus and official project page.
Official and influential, but closer to embodied reasoning background than to this repository's core spatial/action interfaces.
Primary-source benchmark exists, but the scope is narrower and less reusable than the accepted VLA evaluation additions in this run.
